q: Also, a successful transplant is considered a tx (tx=transplant) that lasts 1 year or more. There are some people out there who have had their tx for over 20 years, and they are becoming more common.
1996 April 19, LadyRain1, “New Reader”, in alt.support.kidney-failure (Usenet), archived from the original on 06 Jun 2026:

It's very good to know what is happenning^([sic]) to our tx friends... […] I don't understand why, but my daughter, who had a liver tx on 1988, lives almost like everybody here and, God bless, she has no problems.
1998 December 9, Edvaldo Vasconcelos, “[TRNSPLNT] Colds, flu and life after tx”, in bit.listserv.transplant (Usenet), archived from the original on 06 Jun 2026:
I didn't want to ever nurse again before the tx(transplant) and now with my new health(?) I want to do it again...I am so tired of being home and bored to death.
